question: Endemic species are those species of plants and animals which are _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**found in a particular area.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• **Endemic species** are those species of plants and animals which are found in a particular area.
 
• In ecology, an endemic species is one that is unique to the area in which it is found.
 
• A species might be endemic to a limited geographic area, such as a single island, or a larger geographical area, such as a continent.
 
• **The lion-tailed macaque** is endemic to India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
